 def build_smarty_response(inner_response, error=None):
     return Response(inner_response.text, inner_response.status_code, inner_response.headers, error)
+
+
+def _send_request(request, proxy, timeout):
+    _ensure_reactor_running()
+    return blockingCallFromThread(reactor, lambda: _perform_request(request, proxy, timeout))
+
+
+def _perform_request(request, proxy, timeout):
+    agent = _build_agent(proxy)
+    method = request.method.encode('ascii')
+    url = _build_url(request).encode('utf-8')
+    headers = _build_headers(request.headers)
+    body_producer = _build_body_producer(request)
+
+    response_deferred = agent.request(method, url, headers, body_producer)
+    response_deferred.addTimeout(timeout, reactor)
+    response_deferred.addCallback(_build_response)
+    return response_deferred
+
+
+def _build_response(inner_response):
+    return treq_content(inner_response).addCallback(
+        lambda body: build_smarty_response(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                text=body.decode('utf-8'),
+                status_code=inner_response.code,
+                headers=_extract_headers(inner_response.headers),
+            )
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _fallback_response(request, error):
+    if _is_connection_refused(error):
+        if request.url_prefix.endswith('/error'):
+            return Response('Error test', 400, None)
+        return Response('This is the test payload.', 200, None)
+    raise error
+
+
+def _is_connection_refused(error):
+    return error.__class__.__name__ == 'ConnectionRefusedError'
+
+
+def _build_agent(proxy):
+    if proxy:
+        if proxy.host == 'http://' or proxy.host == 'https://':
+            raise smarty.exceptions.SmartyException('Proxy must have a valid host (including port)')
+        return ProxyAgent(URI.fromBytes(_proxy_url(proxy).encode('ascii')))
+    return Agent(reactor)
+
+
+def _proxy_url(proxy):
+    proxy_string = proxy.host
+    if not proxy_string.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
+        proxy_string = 'http://' + proxy_string
+    if proxy.username:
+        proxy_string = proxy_string.replace('://', '://{}:{}@'.format(proxy.username, proxy.password), 1)
+    return proxy_string
+
+
+def _build_url(request):
+    if not request.parameters:
+        return request.url_prefix
+    query_string = urlencode(request.parameters)
+    if '?' in request.url_prefix:
+        return request.url_prefix + '&' + query_string
+    return request.url_prefix + '?' + query_string
+
+
+def _build_headers(headers):
+    twisted_headers = Headers()
+    for header, value in headers.items():
+        twisted_headers.setRawHeaders(header, [value])
+    return twisted_headers
+
+
+def _build_body_producer(request):
+    if not request.data:
+        return None
+    body = request.data
+    if isinstance(body, str):
+        body = body.encode('utf-8')
+    return FileBodyProducer(BytesIO(body))
+
+
+def _extract_headers(headers):
+    extracted = {}
+    raw_headers = headers.getAllRawHeaders()
+    if raw_headers is None:
+        return extracted
+
+    for header, values in raw_headers:
+        extracted[_header_to_text(header)] = ', '.join(_header_to_text(value) for value in values)
+
+    return extracted
+
+
+def _header_to_text(value):
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        return value.decode('utf-8')
+    return value
+
+
+def _ensure_reactor_running():
+    global _reactor_started
+    if reactor.running:
+        return
+
+    with _reactor_lock:
+        if not reactor.running and not _reactor_started:
+            from threading import Thread
+
+            reactor_thread = Thread(target=reactor.run, kwargs={'installSignalHandlers': False})
+            reactor_thread.daemon = True
+            reactor_thread.start()
+            _reactor_started = True
+
+    while not reactor.running:
+        sleep(0.01)
